mapped_surfaces.finding: _iter_regular_files uses os.walk(..., followlinks=False) and rejects only candidate.is_symlink(). Under CPython 3.12 on Windows, junctions are distinct from symlinks; os.walk's normal False path classifies directory targets with entry.is_dir() and its recursion guard uses os.path.islink(), so a junction is not covered by the existing symlink-only policy. This is the highest-leverage layer to harden because all downstream release gates trust the manifest verifier.

_resolve_declared_route resolves the path before candidate.is_symlink(), so the final check cannot prove that the lexical route was redirect-free. The upstream release-integrity layer currently supplies most of the safety for ordinary symlinks; route-local logic should still use the same centralized path policy rather than a resolve-then-check pattern.

WP1111 improved this layer by checking each lexical component before resolve, but only for symbolic links. It should consume the same centralized redirect-free reference primitive and thereby inherit Windows-junction treatment instead of growing another local rule.

Clean local installation proof is explicitly stronger than repository CI. Any mutation-race or platform-specific path guarantee belongs here only if the host threat model requires it; current WP1111 acceptance must remain static/component scope.

source_composition_finding.statement: The release-manifest walker is the architectural choke point. On Windows CPython 3.12, a directory junction can be seen as a directory while not being a symbolic link; the current os.walk/is_symlink combination can therefore traverse it. If the junction targets outside package_root, lexical relative paths can remain under package_root while reads resolve through the junction. That would violate the intended closed release-tree boundary even though file hashes remain internally consistent.
source_composition_finding.falsifier: On Windows CPython >=3.12, create package_root/ext as a junction to an external directory containing a regular file. Run build_release_manifest and verify_release_manifest. Current source is predicted either to enumerate the external file under ext/... or to fail for a reason other than explicit junction rejection. The desired post-fix behavior is deterministic ReleaseIntegrityError before descent.

proposed_architecture_delta.name: RELEASE_REDIRECT_FREE_PATH_POLICY/v1
principles: One release-path policy, not three partially different path checkers.
Reject lexical absolute paths, dot/dot-dot segments and noncanonical separators before filesystem lookup.
Before descending or consuming a release-tree entry, reject both symbolic links and Windows junctions using CPython-3.12 stdlib capabilities.
Perform root confinement and regular-file/type checks after strict resolution as a second line, not as a substitute for lexical redirect detection.
Manifest generation and verification must use the same tree-walk primitive and semantics.
Pre-handoff route resolution and WP1111 metadata-reference resolution must call the same primitive/policy.
Keep the current guarantee explicitly STATIC_SNAPSHOT_ONLY unless concurrent untrusted mutation is admitted into the threat model.
If concurrent mutation becomes in-scope, add a separate handle-bound real-host verifier; do not pretend a path-string check became race-free.

minimum_stdlib_shape.tree_walk: Recursive os.scandir() or equivalent that checks DirEntry.is_symlink() and DirEntry.is_junction() before descent; reject redirect entries rather than following them.
minimum_stdlib_shape.single_ref: Walk each lexical component from package_root, reject Path.is_symlink() or Path.is_junction(), then strict-resolve and confirm root confinement/type.
minimum_stdlib_shape.external_dependency: NONE for the static portable baseline

proposed_architecture_delta.optional_future_linux_hardened_shape: At real-host acceptance only, if attacker-controlled concurrent mutation is in scope, use a handle-bound resolver based on openat2 RESOLVE_IN_ROOT/RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS or an audited library such as libpathrs. Do not make this Linux-only path a mandatory portable baseline dependency.

tests_for_trigger4: Windows: release-tree external-target directory junction must be rejected before traversal.
Windows: root-internal directory junction must be rejected if the invariant is redirect-free tree identity, even though it remains root-confined.
Windows: pre-handoff route whose intermediate component is a junction must fail explicitly.
Windows: WP1111 metadata evidence/source reference with intermediate junction must fail explicitly.
POSIX: existing intermediate/final symlink regressions remain green after centralization.
Cross-platform: ordinary regular-file package yields exactly the same canonical manifest entries/digest under unchanged inputs.
No runtime/effect/host credit is minted by these static tests.

archive_boundary.current_f2_observation: No tar/zip extraction implementation was located by current repository search for the portable path.
archive_boundary.future_rule: If an archive transport is introduced, extraction becomes a typed predecessor boundary: use an explicit restrictive extraction policy, a fresh destination and then run the release manifest/path policy over the extracted tree. Python 3.12 tar extraction must not rely on its default fully-trusted-equivalent behavior.

counterhypotheses: The release package may be guaranteed to originate only from a trusted immutable builder, making junction traversal impossible in the admitted construction path. If so, the central junction rejection still improves portability/invariant clarity but severity at runtime is lower.

The intended invariant might allow root-internal junctions. If so, that exception must be explicit and separately tested; current prose and symlink-hardening direction instead indicate a redirect-free release tree.

A future clean-machine packaging transport might dereference all junctions into regular directories before the verifier ever sees them. That would reduce exposure but does not make the repository-side integrity primitive correct for arbitrary package_root inputs.

efficiency.expected_cost: negligible additional metadata probes during static release verification

trigger4_handoff.smallest_next_action: Run a Windows CPython >=3.12 junction regression against release_integrity first. If reproduced, centralize release redirect-free path policy and reuse it in WP1110/WP1111; if not reproduced, record the actual Windows traversal semantics and retire or narrow the hypothesis.
trigger4_handoff.do_not_do: Do not import libpathrs/filepath-securejoin before the static-junction falsifier; do not upgrade WP1111 repository CI to host/runtime credit.
